title: Chewy Malaysian Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful noodle stir fry inspired by Malaysian cuisine, featuring chewy noodles, herbs, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped Herba and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced snow peas and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chewy noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the skillet. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
